verdict.rationale: Teams has Copilot integration and agent/bot frameworks (docs-15, docs-31) allowing task delegation to AI assistants, plus agent creation/slash commands (docs-1, docs-6, docs-28), but these are largely developer-facing extensibility docs rather than a clear native 'built-in assistant' delegation UX, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of end-user delegation experience. missing for 10: first-party or hands-on documentation of an end-user delegating multi-step tasks to a built-in assistant (e.g., Copilot agent) within Teams itself, independent corroboration of this working in practice, and clarity distinguishing native built-in AI from third-party developer-built agents.
